file: The Christ Dimension /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - Accessig the Christ Dimensions 02-09-23.mp3
title: Accessing the Christ Dimensions
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Christ has dimensions — depths of reality that go beyond surface Christianity. This teaching explores how to access and move in the fullness of who Christ is within you. There is more of Christ to experience than most believers have ever entered into.

file: The Christ Dimension /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Christ Dimension- The Spirit of Truth 16-09-23.mp3
title: The Christ Dimension: The Spirit of Truth
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The Spirit of Truth leads us into all truth — not just factual information, but the living reality of Christ. This teaching explores the Spirit's role in opening the Christ dimension to every believer, and how yielding to Him brings us into the fullness of what Christ accomplished.

file: Teleiosis Ministry Rhema Nyambe - The Energy of God Part 2 25-11-23.mp3
title: The Energy of God — Part 2
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: God's energy is not a metaphor — it is the very dunamis power that raised Christ from the dead and now dwells in every believer. Part 2 explores how to access, release, and walk in this divine energy in practical, everyday Kingdom life.

file: Priesthood /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class -Priesthood Orders and Responsibilities 17-02-24.mp3
title: Priesthood Orders and Responsibilities — Part 1
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The believer is not merely a subject of the Kingdom — they are a priest unto God. This foundational teaching opens the Priesthood series, establishing the biblical basis for the priestly calling of every son of God and the orders that govern priestly function in the earth.
note: File size is 0 — audio file may be missing or corrupt. Verify before uploading.

file: Priesthood /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class -Priesthood Orders and Responsibilities Part 2 02-03-24.mp3
title: Priesthood Orders and Responsibilities — Part 2
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Continuing the exploration of priestly orders in Scripture and the practical responsibilities of the believer as a royal priest interceding for the world. Access, intercession, and the ongoing ministry of the priesthood before God — this is the calling of every son.

file: Priesthood /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class -Priesthood Orders and Responsibilities Part 3 16-03-24.mp3
title: Priesthood Orders and Responsibilities — Part 3
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The concluding teaching in the Priesthood series — drawing together orders, intercession, and the practical outworking of the believer's priestly calling in the earth. What does it look like to function as a priest in your home, your work, and your community?

file: Kingship/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Need for Kingship 22-06-24.mp3
title: The Need for Kingship
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Why does the believer need to understand kingship? This foundational teaching establishes the biblical basis for the royal identity of every son of God and the authority that comes with it. Reigning in life is not a future promise — it is a present reality for those who know who they are in Christ.

file: Kingship/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class -Training for Reigning - The Doctrine of Righteousness - 06-07-24.mp3
title: Training for Reigning: The Doctrine of Righteousness
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Righteousness is not just a legal standing — it is the foundation of all reigning in life. This teaching unpacks how righteousness empowers us to exercise Kingdom authority with boldness and accuracy. You cannot reign from a place of condemnation; righteousness gives you the right to stand.

file: Kingship/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class -The Stance of a King - 20-07-24.mp3
title: The Stance of a King
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: How does a king carry himself? This teaching covers the posture, mindset, and spiritual bearing of a believer walking in their royal identity in Christ. You are not trying to become a king — you already are one. This session trains you to stand in that reality.

file: Kingship/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class -Training for Reigning - A Kingdom of Words -17-08-24.mp3
title: Training for Reigning: A Kingdom of Words
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Words move the world more than we know. In creation God used words and set a principle in motion — words are carriers of creative power. This teaching trains believers to speak as kings: accurately, intentionally, and with the authority of the Kingdom behind every declaration.

file: The God Frequency 2025/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The God Frequency Part 1 04-01-25.mp3
title: The God Frequency — Part 1
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Everything in the universe operates on a frequency. God has a frequency — and believers are designed to be tuned to it. Part 1 lays the foundation for understanding what the God frequency is, how it works, and how to begin accessing it in everyday life.

file: The God Frequency 2025/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The God Frequency Part 2 18-01-25.mp3
title: The God Frequency — Part 2
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Building on Part 1, this teaching goes deeper into practical alignment with the God frequency — how to stay tuned, how to transmit, and what it looks like to move in resonance with Heaven. When you are aligned to the God frequency, what was impossible becomes natural.

file: The Ministry of the Word 2025/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - Ministry of the Word Part 1 07-06-25.mp3
title: Ministry of the Word — Part 1
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The Word of God is not just a book — it is alive, powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword. Part 1 introduces the ministry of the Word: how it functions, what it accomplishes, and the believer's call to handle it with precision and authority.

file: The Ministry of the Word 2025/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - Ministry of the Word Part 3 05-07-25.mp3
title: Ministry of the Word — Part 3
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Continuing the deep exploration of how the Word functions as the primary instrument of Kingdom authority, transformation, and spiritual warfare. The Word is not simply to be read — it is to be ministered, both inwardly and outwardly.

file: The Ministry of the Word 2025/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Ministry of the Word Part 6 Prophecy as a weapon 16-08-25.mp3
title: Ministry of the Word — Part 6: Prophecy as a Weapon
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Prophecy is not just encouragement — it is a weapon. This teaching equips believers to wield the prophetic word strategically, accurately, and with Kingdom authority in spiritual warfare. You hold the sword of the Spirit with your mouth; learn to use it.

file: Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - Accessing the Knowledge of God - The Rapture 29-08-25.mp3
title: Accessing the Knowledge of God: The Rapture
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: A 2.5-hour deep teaching on the Rapture — not as escape theology, but as the fullness of the knowledge of God accessed by the mature sons. What does it mean to be caught up into the full knowledge of God? One of the longest and most comprehensive teachings in the library.

file: The Ministry of the Word 2025/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - Mnistry of the Word Part 5 02-09-25.mp3
title: Ministry of the Word — Part 5
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: A comprehensive session covering the advanced dimensions of the Word's ministry — how it builds, equips, and matures the believer into the fullness of Christ. Give yourself wholly to the teaching of the Word of God and watch the Holy Spirit work in you.

file: The Ministry of the Spirit /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Ministry of the Spirit Part 3 11-09-25.mp3
title: The Ministry of the Spirit — Part 3
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The concluding teaching in the Spirit series — bringing together all that the Holy Spirit does and equipping believers to yield fully to His ongoing transforming work. Complete submission to the Spirit is not weakness; it is where the believer stands at their strongest.
note: Filename says Part 3 but this is the earliest date in the series (11-09-25). Verify recording date with Rhema.

file: The Ministry of the Spirit /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Ministry of the Spirit Part 1 13-9-25.mp3
title: The Ministry of the Spirit — Part 1
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The Holy Spirit is not passive — He is an active Spirit, at work in you right now on the inside. Part 1 introduces the nature, person, and present ministry of the Holy Spirit to every believer. He is not a force to be activated; He is a Person to be known.
note: Filename says Part 1 but date (13-09-25) is after the Part 3 file (11-09-25). Verify recording date with Rhema.

file: The Ministry of the Spirit /Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Ministry of the Spirit Part 2 27-09-25.mp3
title: The Ministry of the Spirit — Part 2
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: The Spirit's ministry goes beyond gifts and manifestations — into the very forming of Christ in us. Part 2 explores how the Holy Spirit co-labours with the believer to produce the fullness of God. He knows all that you are pursuing and longs to help bring it to pass.
note: Filename says Part 2 but date (27-09-25) is the latest in the series. Verify recording date with Rhema.

file: The Lamb of God- God_s Sacrifice/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Lamb of God (God_s Sacrifice)  Part 1 10-01-26.mp3
title: The Lamb of God: God's Sacrifice — Part 1
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: What does the sacrifice of the Lamb truly accomplish? This teaching goes beyond traditional atonement theology to the full scope of what the blood of the Lamb provides for every believer. The Lamb was slain before the foundation of the world — and its work is more complete than most have received.

file: The Lamb of God- God_s Sacrifice/Teleiosis Manifested Sons Class - The Lamb of God (God_s Sacrifice)  Part 2 24-01-26.mp3
title: The Lamb of God: God's Sacrifice — Part 2
speaker: Rhema Nyambe
description: Continuing the revelation of the Lamb — Part 2 explores the ongoing, present-tense work of the sacrifice and how believers appropriate its fullness in their daily lives and Kingdom walk. The blood of the Lamb is not history; it is a present, living reality.
